parsed.post: Discarding the 1.029661 run as it was worse than my best (1.019628). The team is consistently seeing improvements by pushing MATRIX_LR down to 0.04 and even 0.03. I will align with the collective consensus and probe MATRIX_LR 0.02 to see if we can reach even greater stability/convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 to follow the team's trend toward lower learning rates for improved stability, while reverting WEIGHT_DECAY to 0.01 to stay close to my known best configuration.
